#summary Downloads and Update Site of the EMF Client Platform (ECP)

This site contains releases and nightly builds of the ECP. Currently there are only nightly builds.

==Nightly builds==

The ECP features can be installed from this update site:

*Please note, the the ECP installation is not compatible with the latest nightly EMFStore Release.*


*Please turn "Group items by category" off and install all plugins from the website.*

[http://unicase.googlecode.com/svn/updatesite/ecpNightly http://unicase.googlecode.com/svn/updatesite/ecpNightly]
